name: principal-engineer
description: Engineering discipline as skills: evidence over theory, no silent error swallows, one source of truth, verification as the definition of done, operational safety, and fixes sized to their trigger

interface.shortDescription: The discipline layer for coding agents: ground before coding, fail loud, verify before done, and never let a fix outgrow its trigger.
interface.longDescription: Eleven skills encoding the engineering judgment that survives incidents: a core skill routes and carries the hard rules, with siblings for grounding before coding, failure handling without silent swallows, one source of truth, verification driven at the change's surface, operational safety, scope control, testing changes, unit-test craft, architecture guarding, and dependency vetting.
defaultPrompt: Review this error handling against the no-silent-swallows contract.
Ground this change before we write any code.
